children: Terra's v2.23.0 chain upgrade proposal is scheduled for 25 Oct 2026. The proposal seeks governance approval for improvements to chain security, stability and IBC infrastructure. It also calls for removing restrictions on three wallets that were incorrectly restricted.

The proposed changes address the chain's operation and its infrastructure for communication between blockchains through IBC. The wallet changes would lift the incorrect restrictions on the three affected wallets.
A new Terra Governance proposal seeks approval for the v2.23.0 chain upgrade, bringing improvements to security, stability and IBC infrastructure.
The proposal also removes three incorrectly restricted wallets following further investigation.

title: Terra: v2.23.0 upgrade proposal seeks governance approval - 25 Oct 2026
